title: Compose a positive predictive certificate through clocks and retained-memory reuse
statement: For true/fitted positive joint outcome-next-label columns within local TV t and a shared certified initial simplex state,complete H-step transcript TV<=1-(1-t)^H. An independent abort coin delta before each native call gives b=(1-delta)t/[delta+(1-delta)t]. M sequential adaptive retained-memory invocations have joint complete-transcript TV<=1-(1-b)^M. These bounds are sharp from local-column information.

requires: Both models positive and exactly causal
Same certified simplex start; same legal feedback policy and shared paid abort coin
Uniform local joint-column uncertainty bound from a valid count event
provides: All intermediate outcomes and abort/termination labels retained
No independence of successive physical macro outputs needed
Abstract next-label coupling supports every further legal classical continuation
assumptions: Full starting-state law is not uniform fitted-posterior accuracy after rare histories
Conditioning an event of probability p costs a beta/p-type bound
No terminal physical-memory trace distance,external coherent reference or new intervention library
costs: Expected native calls<=gamma/delta per invocation,tail gamma^n,gamma=1-delta
Count acquisition failure alpha added separately for unconditional acquisition/deployment comparison
Not confidence conditional on returning PASS
contract.units: Complete classical transcript TV,paid clock and native calls
contract.obstruction: Deployment stability after acquisition; does not supply a useful gauge,rare-state access or universal N952.

evidence.range_scope: Final preparation-coordinate theorem,interval positivity and exact causality,full transcript/clock/reuse bounds and synthetic count certificate.
Substantive independent coordinate/coupling audit and sharp rank2 rare-mode starts/activation bound with matched strategy.

body: Exact box-simplex local TV maximizes over subsets; incompatible entry deviations are not simply summed. Coupling is from shared labels,not an unacquired true posterior after arbitrary conditioning.
